title: Glowing snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0f7ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#a0e0ff' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#60c0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id='blur'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2.5'/>
    </filter>
    <filter id='softglow'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='1.5' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='45' fill='url(#glow)' filter='url(#blur)'/>

  <!-- Main snowflake arms: 6-fold symmetry -->
  <g stroke='#b8ecff' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' filter='url(#softglow)'>

    <!-- Vertical arm (12 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='16'/>
    <!-- Branches on vertical -->
    <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='42' y2='24' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='58' y2='24' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='45' y2='18' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='55' y2='18' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- Bottom arm (6 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='70' x2='42' y2='76' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='70' x2='58' y2='76' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='78' x2='45' y2='82' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='78' x2='55' y2='82' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- Upper right arm (~2 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='79' y2='21'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='37' x2='70' y2='32' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='37' x2='66' y2='28' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='30' x2='74' y2='26' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='30' x2='76' y2='33' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- Lower right arm (~4 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='79' y2='79'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='63' x2='70' y2='68' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='63' x2='66' y2='72' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='70' x2='74' y2='74' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='70' x2='76' y2='67' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- Upper left arm (~10 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='21' y2='21'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='37' x2='30' y2='32' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='37' x2='34' y2='28' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='30' x2='26' y2='26' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='30' x2='24' y2='33' stroke-width='2'/>

    <!-- Lower left arm (~8 o'clock) -->
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='21' y2='79'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='63' x2='30' y2='68' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='37' y1='63' x2='34' y2='72' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='70' x2='26' y2='74' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='70' x2='24' y2='67' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Center hexagon detail -->
  <polygon points='50,40 58,45 58,55 50,60 42,55 42,45'
           fill='#d4f4ff' stroke='#8ae0ff' stroke-width='1.5' filter='url(#softglow)'/>

  <!-- Small center sparkle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff' filter='url(#softglow)'/>

  <!-- Tiny floating sparkles around -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='90' r='1' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='10' r='1' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='65' r='1.2' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ccf0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
